title: Intro and why Mahalia refuses jazz and blues; Armstrong's pitch
summary: Helen O'Connell introduces Mahalia Jackson. She says she loves spirituals and was taught jazz and blues were sinful; Louis Armstrong and Earl Hines urged her to join them.
